Definition: Luchith, a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Luhith was a place east of the Jordan, on the road up from Moab, where fugitives fled weeping when judgment fell. Isaiah cries out for Moab as its people go up to Luhith with weeping, and Jeremiah repeats the same going up in his oracle against Moab.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Luhith stands in Scripture as a road of tears, and the prophets name it so we feel what judgment costs real people.
